title: Tech 21 SansAmp Programmable Bass Driver DI Elite

device.model: SansAmp Programmable Bass Driver DI Elite

x_pc.additionalInfo: Program Change recalls Studio Mode locations (128). Performance Mode has 3 additional footswitch slots; PC mapping for those is unit/app dependent.

additionalInfo: 3.5mm Type A MIDI via included Tech 21 MIDI Driver. No MIDI CC parameter map — deep editing (amps, IRs, effects, EQ) is app/SysEx only. Hardware MIDI is PC for preset recall plus the Tech 21 software protocol.
